title: Direct the original Nike Air Max 2017 ad
source: The first 28 seconds of the original Nike Europe / ManvsMachine / Zelig Sound advertisement from the D&AD archive, ending before the JD Sports retailer card.
opening: I am going to direct this Nike ad by talking to it and pointing at the screen.
openingNote: Say this to the audience BEFORE clicking Start directing. The recognizer should hear editing instructions only.
rehearsal: Click Cue moment to pause on the exact original frame. Look at the main video, point with the mouse, then speak one line. Wait for Applied before continuing. Cue controls only move the playhead.

steps.title: Frame the product
steps.direction: Okay, zoom in on this shoe a little.
steps.where: The grey Nike Air Max shoe on the blue background, near the end of the ad.
steps.gesture: Point the mouse at the shoe first. In the camera, lean forward and frame the shoe with both hands. Hold the pose for a second as you finish speaking.
steps.expected: Only the product reveal becomes a tighter crop centered on your pointer.
steps.check: After Applied, press Space for a brief preview, then pause again.

steps.title: Give a follow-up
steps.direction: Whoa, that is too close. Back off a little.
steps.where: Stay on the same grey product shoe.
steps.gesture: Lean back with a small head shake. Bring your hands slightly inward to ask for a smaller crop. Say the full line; the reaction alone is not an edit.
steps.expected: The previous zoom becomes less tight. Other sections stay unchanged.
steps.check: Wait for Applied. The crop should sit between the original and the first zoom.

steps.title: Slow the water shot
steps.direction: Hold on. Slow this shot down to half speed.
steps.where: The pale blue shoe made from moving water, immediately after the pink foam shoe.
steps.gesture: Show one open palm toward the camera, then lower it slowly while saying half speed. Keep the source frame paused.
steps.expected: Only source 5.32 to 6.00 plays at 0.5x. Later shots move later in the output.
steps.check: Wait for Applied, then press Space to see the water move more slowly.

steps.title: Adjust the water shot
steps.direction: This feels a little cold. Make it warmer.
steps.where: The same water shoe, against the blue background.
steps.gesture: Look between the footage and the camera, then make a small turning gesture with your hand as if adjusting a dial.
steps.expected: A subtle warmer grade is applied to the water shot only.
steps.check: Wait for Applied. The original pink montage and product reveal keep their colors.

steps.title: Add the headline
steps.direction: Add FEEL THE AIR as a caption down here.
steps.where: Return to the grey Nike product shoe at source 24.68 seconds.
steps.gesture: Point the mouse to the empty blue space below the product. In the camera, point downward with one finger. Emphasize FEEL THE AIR clearly.
steps.expected: FEEL THE AIR appears below the product during source 23.80 to 25.32. Original end-card text stays in the original video.
steps.check: Wait for Applied. Look for a single caption below the shoe.

steps.title: Refine the caption
steps.direction: Make the caption bigger, and move it up a little.
steps.where: The new FEEL THE AIR caption beneath the product shoe.
steps.gesture: Spread your hands slightly for bigger, then gently lift one palm for higher. Keep the caption in view and say both changes.
steps.expected: The same caption grows and moves upward slightly, without duplicating it or covering the shoe.
steps.check: Wait for Applied. Confirm the wording is unchanged and the shoe is readable.

steps.title: Undo one decision
steps.where: Stay on the captioned product frame.
steps.gesture: Make a small backward wave. Keep the reaction natural, and say undo explicitly.
steps.expected: The caption returns to its previous size and position. Caption text, product zoom and slowed water remain.

steps.title: Watch the result
steps.direction: Good. Play it from the beginning.
steps.gesture: Relax your hands and watch the finished ad. Wait until it ends before clicking Stop directing.
steps.expected: The edited original Nike ad plays from the beginning.
steps.check: Watch through the Nike end card, then click Stop directing.

finish: After Stop directing, say: Every change you just saw was applied to the original video through Shoty.
timing: Expect several seconds of interpretation and rendering per edit. Speak the next line only after Applied or Undone. A recorded demo may speed up waiting with a visible speed-up label.
generationExtension: This rehearsal edits the original Nike advertisement. Stock footage and generated replacement advertisements are outside this demo.
performance: Act like a director giving a useful note: watch the image first, react briefly, then give one clear instruction. Keep your face and both hands in the camera. Mouse pointing identifies an exact spot; camera gestures reinforce the spoken intent.
